subject: Security gate sprint: MAP close timeline & evidence leads
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@orionhealth.com>, security@orionhealth.com
Date: Fri, 10 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Security gate sprint: MAP close timeline & evidence leads

Hi team,

Quick sync after yesterday's MAP review — Orion pushed the target close to the end of this month, so we need to compress the security evidence runway and lock owners for each item. Attached is an updated MAP evidence checklist (v2) with my proposed owners in the right-most column. Please review and confirm by EOD today:

Key asks from Orion: SOC 2 evidence bundle, DPA redline responses, audit-log export sample, and a pen test window in March.

Proposed immediate owners (please confirm or assign):
- SOC 2: Kimberly Park (control mapping, evidence export)
- DPA redlines & legal coordination: Neha Kapoor
- Audit logs sample (retention + schema): Priyom Das + Infra Eng (I'll coordinate)
- Pen test scheduling: Alex/Orion request — we need to propose 2 windows

Action items I want to capture in the thread for the MAP close timeline:
1) Kimberly to upload SOC 2 evidence folder to the shared Drive (deadline: 2028-02-16) — attach link once done.
2) Neha to review DPA redlines and return a marked-up PDF to Alex (deadline: 2028-02-14).
3) Priyom to generate a 7-day audit-log export sample and notes on retention policy (deadline: 2028-02-15).
4) Priyom to propose pen test windows to Alex (options: 2028-03-06 or 2028-03-13).

I've attached the checklist (MAP-evidence-checklist-v2.xlsx) and a draft one-pager we can send to Orion clarifying what each evidence bundle contains. Our goal: close the MAP signature + legal by 2028-02-28 while getting SOC 2 artifacts staged for their internal reviewers.

If you see any gaps in owners/timing call them out here and I'll update the file. I'll also pull a short task list into HubSpot once we confirm owners.

Thanks —
Priyom
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
--
Attachment: MAP-evidence-checklist-v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@orionhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Feb 2028 12:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Security gate sprint: MAP close timeline & evidence leads

Thanks Priyom — I can take SOC 2 evidence. Quick clarifications:
- I will assemble the control evidence directory, but need confirmation on log retention snapshot timeframe (30 vs 90 days) to decide what artifacts to pull.
- Will upload to the shared Drive by 2028-02-16 as suggested.

Question for Neha: do we want legal to pre-approve the DPA changes before I finalize any artifact exports that reference retention policy? I can hold on exports if Neha thinks redlines will change scope.

I'll mark items in the checklist that are blocked by retention decisions.

Kimberly
Director, Security Programs
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@orionhealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, security@orionhealth.com
Date: Sat, 11 Feb 2028 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Security gate sprint: MAP close timeline & evidence leads

Appreciate the quick turnaround, Priyom. A couple points from our side:
- DPA: I've attached our initial redlines. We prefer a 90-day retention disclosure for the logs you will provide, but we can be flexible if you provide the retention controls clearly.
- Pen test: We'd like the 2028-03-06 window as primary and 2028-03-13 as fallback; please confirm availability.
- Can you provide an audit-log export sample showing fields and redaction behavior (PII removal) before 2028-02-15? Our security reviewers need to see format.

I've uploaded our redlines (redlines_dpa_orion_20280211.pdf) and added a quick DocuSign placeholder for the non-standard terms we discussed: https://docusign.com/ORH-4721-dpa

Regards,
Alex Mercer
Head of Security Integrations, Orion Health
--
Attachment: redlines_dpa_orion_20280211.pdf (PDF, 18KB)

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@orionhealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, security@orionhealth.com
Date: Mon, 12 Feb 2028 10:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Security gate sprint: MAP close timeline & evidence leads

Thanks Alex — confirmation below and consolidated action list.

Resolved items / confirmations:
- Pen test windows: 2028-03-06 (primary) and 2028-03-13 (fallback). I've flagged both with Infra; they'll confirm scheduled maintenance windows by 2028-02-17.
- DPA redlines: Neha will produce a marked-up response and proposed counterlanguage; target 2028-02-14. If DPA changes retention language materially we will update the SOC exports accordingly.
- Audit-log sample: I'll produce a 7-day export with redaction notes and schema on or before 2028-02-15.

Consolidated action items (owners & dates):
- Kimberly Park: Upload SOC 2 evidence directory to shared Drive (2028-02-16) — LINK_TO_DRIVE_PLACEHOLDER
- Neha Kapoor: Return DPA response + redline comments (2028-02-14) — Attachment: redlines_dpa_orion_20280211.pdf noted
- Priyom Das: Generate audit-log sample + retention explanation (2028-02-15)
- Priyom Das: Confirm pen test windows with Infra and circle back (2028-02-17)
- Priyom to update HubSpot tasks after owners confirm (2028-02-12)

Next steps:
- Kimberly/Neha — please reply to this thread with any blocking concerns.
- Alex — once you confirm the DocuSign link and pen test acceptance, we'll queue the MAP for signature and set the legal milestone for 2028-02-28.

I'll follow up with a short checklist message to HubSpot and post the Drive link as soon as Kimberly uploads. Thanks all for the quick coordination.

Priyom
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
